allocation.rationale: Cognitive reset performed despite the inherited mandate being a prior-cycle decision. Fresh look: with today's Codex and no handoff, Graph would still choose C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, because it is the only Graph claim carrying a fresh, decidable, non-product-gated signal (45/52 vs 33/52 embedding-vs-token-overlap, bounded below ceiling, EXP-GRAPH-36287167610) and because semantic resolution with calibrated abstention is a safety/blocking capability the product's resolve step needs. The alternative Graph threads lose on merits now: C-FRESHNESS Part II is structurally PARKed (single-anchor, transport-coupled D1V population with no constructible redesign on the pinned anchors, EXP-GRAPH-37992949248), C-DELTA-REPAIR is already a bounded single-node positive whose distributed scale-up has low marginal decision value, and C-PARAM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-LLM-INHERIT are gated on B1/B2/B3 owned by Product/Runtime/Intel. The active prefreeze experiment EXP-GRAPH-38149485714 targets exactly this claim and its objective remains strategically correct, so per policy this is a CONTINUE with the same mandate rather than a re-aim; its design crashed empty (spec.json claim_ids=[], question='', all six checks PENDING) purely from the shared outage, so the pre-freeze transaction must be re-issued, not rewritten.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 436 canonical experiments; effective claim state C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED at the bounded authorship-separated real-Chromium scope (EXP-RUNTIME-36293257855); C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS. No frozen transaction is pending anywhere: all six lanes' active experiments are PREFREEZE and none has a freeze.json, so nothing must be completed under an old design. This cycle opened with a control-plane event, verified at source on origin/lab2/<lane>: graph, intel, physics and runtime all failed the DESIGN stage at 15:31-15:51 UTC with the SAME fingerprint (3b9ff5e4e9e73f23e368efb4, 'stage exited with code 1') while the Scout model was unavailable (rc=139) - one shared infrastructure outage, not four scientific design defects. Inspection of the actual specs separates cleanly: physics, intel and runtime had substantively complete designs (all six freeze_eligibility checks PASS with evidence refs; physics even pre-provisioned and pinned a distinct Tor egress at DESIGN) and lost only the review step; graph and product still carry the EMPTY spec template (claim_ids=[], question='', all six checks PENDING), so their designs never started. Frontier is different: its spec declares all six checks PASS but its own declared freeze_artifacts (design_probe/pool_confirmation.json, research/frontier/discovery_channels.py) are ABSENT from the branch and failure.json records exit 65 - a genuine design-contract failure whose root is an unattainable pre-freeze attainability prerequisite, not the outage. The strategic critical path is unchanged and confirmed by PROGRAM_AUDIT_GLOBAL_2026-10-10: the factory produces evidence but no validated external-agent product. The three gated blockers stand - B1 no shipped parameterized carrier (src/spider/kernel.py has no distill_parameterized and a 0.5/0.8 confidence mismatch), B2 benchmark degeneracy (cold/retrieval at the 1.0 correctness ceiling on the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class), B3 unresolved same-model agent capability (0/5 and 0/5 on local 3B/7B). The three-conditions rule therefore forbids funding any full C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON four-arm execution this cycle; every lane is directed at a cheap prerequisite, a decidable local question, or an attainable measurement instead. Decision: CONTINUE Product on B1 (empty design, re-issued), Runtime on B2 (complete design, resume), Intel on B3 (complete design, resume), Physics on C-WEB-DYNAMICS vantage transfer (complete design, resume), Graph on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE joint-authorship confound removal (empty design, re-issued); PIVOT Frontier off the twice-blocked conditional-reachability design onto an attainability-first, always-satisfiable discovery census of the SAME architectural question. No lane is PARKed or TERMINATED: each has a high-value decidable next step and none is idle after this allocation. Local-attractor flags on graph, physics and runtime were treated as diagnostics; the cognitive reset confirmed the inherited direction on merits in each case.
